grid.method: native valid-pixel mean in each bin; no interpolation; equal-galaxy median; excluded and empty values NaN

feature_metric: sum native fitted pulls / sqrt(number fitted band pixels)

interval_ranking.scope: 15 non-overlapping windows per arm; rank max absolute mean of five stacked bins over the two eligible groups; all bins outside every feature and masked emission-line window

bootstrap.method: percentile; independent galaxy resampling in each group

matched_comparison: mean binned pull per galaxy on fixed common fully-contained 2 A bins of each feature, only galaxies finite on every selected bin; difference of group medians
chi2_definition: spectral fitted native pixels only; signed sum(pull^2-1); fractions partition four-carbon-band union, Mgb, complement; not clipped
